dialogue.content: はじめまして。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: 予定時刻に開始させてもらいます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: We will begin at the scheduled time. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はじめまして。よろしくお願いします。一時から、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you. Please start from 1 o'clock.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめにご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは12才女子です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a 12-year-old girl.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 友達が、本当の友達がいないかもしれないです。
dialogue.English: I feel like I might not have any real friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。信頼できる友達がいないとつらいですよね。どのようなことがきっかけでそう感じるようになったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult not to have friends you can trust. What made you start feeling that way?

dialogue.content: 中学生になって、話す友達はいましたが、自分の本心が話せるこがいないな、と。この前三者面談で担任の先生に言われて、やっぱりそうみえるんだ、と改めて思いました。
dialogue.English: Since starting junior high, I have friends to talk to, but no one I can share my true feelings with. Recently, during a parent-teacher-student conference, my homeroom teacher mentioned it, and I thought, 'So it really does look that way to others.'

dialogue.content: 先生からそう言われたのです。確かにそう言われると「そうなのかな」って不安なりますよね。
dialogue.English: Your teacher said that to you. I can imagine hearing that would make you feel anxious, wondering if it's true.

dialogue.content: はい、でも本当のことだから。
dialogue.English: Yes, but it's the truth.

dialogue.content: そう感じるのですね。今回の悩みは友達に本音を言えるようになりたいということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand you feel that way. Is your concern that you want to be able to share your true feelings with friends?

dialogue.content: 本音を話せる友達って、どうやったら作れるのか、ですかね…。今は見当たらなくて。
dialogue.English: I guess it's about how to make friends I can be honest with... I can't seem to find any right now.

dialogue.content: 確かに他の人がどやって友達を作っているのかわからないから不安になりますよね。なので、一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel anxious when you're not sure how other people make friends. So, let's think about it together.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 友達に本音が言えないなと感じるようになったのはいつから言えなくなったなどありますか？
dialogue.English: When did you start feeling like you couldn't be honest with your friends? Is there a specific time you remember?

dialogue.content: 気がついたら、いえてないなという感じかな。中学になってグラスで新しい友達や今までのつづきや、混ざって色々関係あったけど、この一年、深く信頼できる関係はないな、と気づきました。
dialogue.English: I guess I just realized it at some point. In middle school, with new friends in class and old ones, and everyone mixing, there were a lot of different relationships, but I noticed over the past year that I don't have any deeply trusting relationships.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。確かに知らない人とすぐに打ち解けるの難しいですもんね。この一年間一人で悩んでとてもつらかったですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's certainly difficult to open up to new people right away. It must have been very hard for you, worrying about this alone for the past year.

dialogue.content: 行き違いで溝が出来たりしました。今は様子見ている感じです。
dialogue.English: We had some misunderstandings that created a rift. Now I'm just kind of seeing how things go.

dialogue.content: そのような人間関係で上手くいかなかったできごとがあったんですね。よければ教えていただいても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So there were incidents where relationships didn't go well. If you're comfortable, could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: 比較的一瞬にいる、小学校からの友達を私の気遣いのなさから怒らせてしまって。それは謝れて落ち着いたのだけど、それからちょっと距離が出来て。その回りにいた子達とも、ちょっと距離が出来て。私はあまりそこに居場所を感じなくなりました。
dialogue.English: I upset a friend I've known since elementary school, who I spent a lot of time with, because I was inconsiderate. I apologized and things calmed down, but there's been some distance between us since then. And the other kids around her have become distant too. I don't really feel like I belong there anymore.

dialogue.content: 確かにケンカした後って仲直りしても気まずいですねもんね。周りに友達とも距離ができると嫌われてないか不安になると思います。それなら、本音は言えないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's true that even after you make up, things can feel awkward after a fight. And when the friends around you also become distant, I imagine you'd worry if they dislike you. It makes sense that you wouldn't be able to be honest in that situation.

dialogue.content: はい。そんな感じです。本音を言える友達がいてほしいとも思う反面、今はちょっと人間不信もあるのか、積極的になれないのもあるかもです。
dialogue.English: Yes. That's how it is. On one hand, I want friends I can be honest with, but on the other, I think I have a bit of a trust issue with people right now, and maybe that's why I can't be proactive.

dialogue.content: これ以上傷つきたくないって思ってしまいますよね。どうして積極的になれないと思いますか？
dialogue.English: It’s understandable to feel you don’t want to be hurt any further. Why do you think it’s hard to be proactive?

dialogue.content: いろいろあると、ちょっと疲れちゃったかな、と。
dialogue.English: I guess I'm just a little tired from everything that's happened.

dialogue.content: 確かにまた「めんどくさいが起こるじゃないか」って思うと積極的にいきづらいですよね。
dialogue.English: I can see that. It's hard to be proactive when you're worried that more trouble will just happen again.

dialogue.content: 今の私の状況は、ちゃんとした友達がいないのはおかしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Given my current situation, is it strange that I don’t have solid friends?

dialogue.content: そうんなことないですよ。つらいことがあったら友達ほしいと思っても疲れちゃうからなかなか上手くいかないですよね。なので、また友達と本音で話せるように一緒に考えましょう。
dialogue.English: Not at all. When you've been through something difficult, it's natural to feel too tired to make friends, even if you want them. So, let's think together about how you can get to a place where you can speak honestly with friends again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ただ、今までも、本音で話せた友達っていなかった気がして。だから、そんな友達をどうしたら出来るのかな、って最近思うんです。
dialogue.English: Thank you. But, thinking back, I feel like I've never really had a friend I could be completely honest with. That's why I've been wondering lately how I can make friends like that.

dialogue.content: 確かに今が上手くいってないと悩みますよね。友達と溝ができる前も本音で話せていなかったのですか？
dialogue.English: It's natural to worry when things aren't going well now. Were you unable to share your true feelings even before the rift with your friends?

dialogue.content: そうですね。思い返してみれば。その子とは気がすごくあってたわけでもなく。同じ学校だったから、なんとなく一緒にいた、みたいな感じでした。だから、こだわっているわけではないですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, thinking back. It’s not like I really clicked with that girl. We were at the same school, so we just kind of spent time together. So it’s not that I’m particularly attached to that friendship.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。なんとなく一緒にいることってありますよね。あなたの中で本音が言える人っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's common to just hang out with people for no particular reason, isn't it? Is there anyone in your life you feel you can be honest with?

dialogue.content: 今はいないですね、
dialogue.English: Not right now, no.

dialogue.content: 友達として、は。
dialogue.English: As a friend, I mean.

dialogue.content: 友達以外ではいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone besides friends?

dialogue.content: 母親なら、だいたい本音で話せるけど。友達の悩みを母親に話すのは、ちょっと…。
dialogue.English: I can be mostly honest with my mother. But talking to my mom about my friend problems is a bit...

dialogue.content: 確かに友達の悩みは話しづらいですよね。心配かけたくないし、どうして、お母さんは本音で話しやすいと感じますか？
dialogue.English: It's true, it can be hard to talk about friend problems. You don't want to make her worry. Why do you feel it's easy to be honest with your mother?

dialogue.content: いつもだいたい、本音で話していたからでしょうか。いつも私の味方してたくれてる感じがして。
dialogue.English: Maybe because we've always been pretty honest with each other. I feel like she's always on my side.

dialogue.content: あなたの味方をしてくれるなら話しやすいですね。そのようなあなたが居心地がいい関係の友達はいましたか？
dialogue.English: It's easy to talk to someone when you know they're on your side. Have you ever had a friendship where you felt that comfortable?

dialogue.content: 今までは、いないですね、
dialogue.English: Not so far, no.

dialogue.content: 多分。
dialogue.English: I don't think so.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それならまだ本音で話せる友達にで会ってないだけかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, it might just be that you haven't met a friend you can be honest with yet.

dialogue.content: はい。これからどうしたら出会えるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Yes. How can I meet friends like that from now on?

dialogue.content: あなたはお母さんとどのようにして話ているから居心地が良いと感じますか？
dialogue.English: What is it about the way you talk with your mother that makes you feel so comfortable?

dialogue.content: お互い大事な存在だからでしょうか、家族ですから。私を生んで育ててくれた母ですから。絶対の信頼があります。
dialogue.English: Maybe because we're important to each other, because we're family. She's the mother who gave birth to me and raised me. I have absolute trust in her.

dialogue.content: 確かに信頼できるからこそあなたが本音で話せるしお母さんも本音を言いやすいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: It's true, that trust is likely what allows you to be honest, and it might make it easier for your mother to be honest with you as well.

dialogue.content: （お時間過ぎてしまい申し訳ありません）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, we've gone over our time.)

dialogue.content: (いえいえ。クロージングに入り大丈夫です。お願いします。)
dialogue.English: (No, no. It's okay to start wrapping up. Please go ahead.)

dialogue.content: お母さんが本音で言ってくれるからこそあなたも本音で話しやすいと思います。なので、友達に対してもあなたが本音を言ってあげればいい関係が気付けるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I think you find it easy to be honest with your mother precisely because she is honest with you. So, perhaps if you try being honest with your friends, you might be able to build that kind of good relationship.

dialogue.content: 本音ですね…。できるかどうか。
dialogue.English: Being honest... I'm not sure if I can do that.

dialogue.content: 確かに不安ですよね。本音を言ってめんどくさことになると嫌だし。すいませんがお時間になりましたのでまた後日相談してもらってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's understandable to feel anxious. You don't want things to get complicated because you shared your true feelings. I'm sorry, but our time is up. Would it be alright if we continued this conversation another day?

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それでは、本日のご相談はここで終了とさせていただきます。お時間を作ってお話をお聞かせいただき、どうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: In that case, we'll end today's consultation here. Thank you very much for taking the time to share your story.

dialogue.content: はい。聞いていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: （長い間対応していただきありがとうございました。　また、よろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time and cooperation. I look forward to working with you again.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. I appreciate your time.)
